//: framework is pinned deliberately. This project was imported with framework
detection returning null, so Vercel ran a static build and failed with 'No
Output Directory named public found' — a Next.js app emits .next, never
public/. Setting it here overrides the project setting and keeps the fix in
version control, where a re-import cannot lose it.
The commands are explicit for the same reason: prebuild runs tsx to build
the search index, so the install must include devDependencies.
